newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares inch higher as upbeat mood prevails.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares inch higher as upbeat mood prevails.

text.p: Shares on Qatar's unofficial stock market ended the week to Thursday on an upbeat note, with seven shares advancing and 10 staying firm, brokers said.

Qatar Insurance was the week's only decliner, with the share price slipping for the fourth straight week. The stock shed another five riyals to 645 amid market expectations of lower than projected 1996 profits.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index crept up 0.12 points in the week to close at 126.44, continuing the market's upward trend.
Qatar General Insurance added 10 riyals to 585 and Qatar Cinema gained five riyals to 190.

Qatar Islamic Bank moved up 2.5 riyals to 125 after a long period of stagnation, and Qatar International Islamic Bank inched up half a riyal to 85.50. Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company also ticked up half a riyal to 55.
Qatar Cement and Qatar Flour Mills advanced two riyals each to 317 and 313 respectively.
